group.title: Hybrid supplier forum
group.passage:
Supplier Forum — Participant information

The forum begins at 9:30 a.m. in Harbor Hall. Registration opens at 8:45. Remote participants will receive a viewing link the previous afternoon; the same link works for all morning presentations.

The afternoon workshop involves reviewing sample contracts in small groups and is available only to people attending in person. Lunch is included for on-site participants. Anyone with a dietary requirement should notify the organizer by Monday.

Slides will be emailed to all registered participants after the event. A recording of the presentations will not be provided because several speakers will discuss unpublished business plans.
group.passageZh:
供應商論壇——參加資訊

論壇上午九點半於 Harbor Hall 開始，八點四十五分開放報到。遠端參加者會在前一天下午收到觀看連結；上午所有簡報皆使用同一連結。

下午工作坊會分組檢視合約範例，僅供現場參加者加入。現場參加者的午餐已包含在內。有飲食需求者應最遲於星期一通知主辦單位。

活動結束後，所有已報名者都會收到簡報投影片的電子郵件。由於部分講者將討論尚未公開的商業計畫，主辦單位不提供簡報錄影。
